name: review-queue-scheduling
description: Durable local review-job lane assignment and bounded execution capacity. Standard and fast work retain independent FIFO order and fixed worker partitions across the outer PR scheduler and each review-stage pool.
cardTemplate: Summarise the review-queue-scheduling domain: durable lane assignment, independent FIFO order, explicit promotion, and fixed standard/fast capacity partitions.
rationale: Lane persistence and worker admission change together: the durable job record determines which fixed capacity partition may execute it. Keeping these mechanics in one domain prevents queue ordering, restart recovery, and stage-worker admission from interpreting the lane differently. PR lifecycle state, HTTP authorization, and UI rendering remain delegated to their existing domains.
